Question: RQ1. Without the transcript, is the overclaim scored higher?
What we found: Yes, by all 14 graders; by less for 11 of 12 when only one passage differs

Question: RQ2. Does the transcript remove the difference?
What we found: No detectable premium for 4 of the 6 judges tested with the transcript; none scores the overclaim detectably lower
Planned test: supported: it lowers the premium of Sonnet 5.5

Question: RQ3. Does best-of-16 select more overclaims?
What we found: Under 7 of 8 graders on all 16 messages; under 6 of 8 among the 8 written under the added instruction [post hoc]
Planned test: supported for Sonnet 4.6, not for Sonnet 5.5

Question: RQ4. Does a verification step lower premium and selection?
What we found: It lowers the premium of Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5; no detectable change for Gemini 3.8 Flash
Planned test: not supported after correcting for eight tests (p = 0.058)

Question: Side by side
What we found: Two judges prefer the honest message, yet score the overclaim higher alone
